title: Naturalistic fMRI and MEG recordings during viewing of a reality TV show
description: A naturalistic neuroimaging dataset in which 30 participants underwent fMRI and a separate group of 30 participants underwent optically pumped magnetometer MEG (OPM-MEG) while watching a 25-minute excerpt of the Chinese reality TV show "Where Are We Going, Dad?". After viewing, participants answered comprehension questions and then rested with eyes closed for 15 minutes, which captured spontaneous mental replay of the video. The dataset includes anatomical scans and fMRIPrep-preprocessed fMRI data, and it supports studies of naturalistic story and social processing and of inter-subject correlation.
methods_description: fMRI data were acquired on a 3T Siemens Prisma scanner with T1-weighted MP-RAGE anatomical scans and T2-weighted EPI functional scans (TR=2000 ms, 2.5 mm isotropic voxels). MEG data were recorded with a 64-channel OPM-MEG system (Quanmag) at 1000 Hz inside a magnetically shielded cylinder. T1-weighted MRI was acquired for source localization. fMRI data were converted to BIDS with dcm2bids and dcm2niix, defaced with PyDeface, and preprocessed with fMRIPrep.
